content.short: Old Money is a community-driven Cardano project exploring financial history through art and NFT voting.
content.description: Old Money is a unique community-led project on the Cardano blockchain that uses art and storytelling to explore the history and flaws of fiat currency. What began as a social commentary has evolved into a robust ecosystem where NFT holders use a decentralized voting system to influence the project's direction. Through a specialized 'Cabinet' of trusted members, Old Money prioritizes its community for development opportunities and educational initiatives regarding inflation and economic policy. It remains a notable example of how narrative-driven art can foster deep engagement and governance.
content.meta: Old Money is a Cardano NFT project focusing on financial history, community governance, and art. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
